analysis: New exploratory Eigen-CAM analysis of newly trained primary YOLO11

environment.note: Recorded during this replay; historical evaluation did not record these numerical flags. No flags changed by the CAM repair.

target_layer_policy: Final top-level spatial block immediately before the Classify head; frozen before visualization

preprocessing.source: Official loaded YOLO ClassificationPredictor, same forward pass as saved CAM probabilities
preprocessing.transforms_repr:
Compose(
    SpineResizePad(size=640, interpolation=BILINEAR, fill=(0,0,0), crop=False)
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=[0, 0, 0], std=[1, 1, 1])
)
preprocessing.overlay_coordinates: Actual model-input tensor after whole-PNG aspect-preserving resize and square padding; inverse normalization only for display

eigen_cam_method.pca: float64 SVD of spatial-position × feature-channel matrix, centered per feature channel
eigen_cam_method.projection: Centered activations projected onto the first right singular vector
eigen_cam_method.sign_convention: Loading with greatest absolute magnitude is made positive; first channel breaks exact tie
eigen_cam_method.normalization: Clip negative projection to zero, divide by spatial maximum; constant maps remain zero
eigen_cam_method.resampling: Bilinear interpolation to exact input tensor dimensions
eigen_cam_method.smoothing: No Gaussian, augmentation, or eigen-smoothing; only bilinear display resampling
eigen_cam_method.overlay: turbo color map on [0,1], 40% heatmap + 60% inverse-normalized model input
eigen_cam_method.limitations: Illustrative feature patterns; not class-specific causal explanations, localization validation, or proof against shortcut learning

selection.rule: Correct: first lexicographic relative_path per reference class. Errors: first per available reference class, then remaining lexicographic paths, maximum four, no duplicate path. No confidence-based selection.
selection.absent_strata: No image fabricated when a correct class or error stratum is absent

evaluation_provenance.note: Seed and layer are fixed in advance; no best-external-seed selection
evaluation_provenance.correction_scope: CAM capture now uses exact evaluation batch composition; training and evaluation are read-only
